column_description: Unique identifier for each performance metric.
ID of the robot. may be NULL.
ID of the motion path. may be NULL.
Name of the performance metric (e.g., cycle time, efficiency). always exactly one of 'cycle time', 'efficiency'. may be NULL.
Value of the performance metric. may be NULL.
Date the metric was recorded. may be NULL.
Unit of the metric (e.g., seconds, percent). always exactly one of 'seconds', 'percent'. may be NULL.
Target value for the metric. may be NULL.
Threshold value for the metric. may be NULL.
